# setup_poisson_spectral_gpu { #mofography.compute.setup_poisson_spectral_gpu }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-alternate">alternate</span> GPU variant of spectral Poisson setup; CPU setup is the usual path.

```python
compute.setup_poisson_spectral_gpu(atoms, grid_shape)
```

Set up the system for solving the Poisson equation using a spectral method.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type   | Description                            | Default    |
|------------|--------|----------------------------------------|------------|
| atoms      |        | ASE Atoms object                       | _required_ |
| grid_shape |        | Tuple of grid points in each direction | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                         |
|--------|--------|-----------------------------------------------------|
|        |        | Charge density on grid, grid shape, and cell matrix |
